findings: Detected-gene counts must be integral before conversion.
Mitochondrial flags accept Boolean or numeric 0/1 values and reject arbitrary truthy numbers/strings.
Source hashing, identifier-aligned raw counts and normalization checks remain intact.
limitation: Independent static re-review found both reported coercion defects addressed. The fresh wrong-answer probe tests omitted gene filtering, not explicit fractional-count or nonbinary-flag mutations. Numeric 0/1 mitochondrial flags remain accepted; strict Boolean dtype is not required.
